title: knautia nevadensis var. lanceolata
intro: Knautia nevadensis var. lanceolata, commonly known as Nevada or Spurred Knautia, is a flowering plant species within the family Caprifoliaceae. This plant is used in traditional medicine due to its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Nevada Spurred Knautia include treating digestive issues, such as diarrhea, and skin conditions, like eczema, as well as providing relief from respiratory problems like bronchitis. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
